name: Acid Arrow
description: You conjure a corrosive bolt that hits one foe, dealing 1d6 damage a round. The bolt remains in the target for as long as you focus.
paragraphs: You conjure a corrosive bolt that hits one foe, dealing 1d6 damage a round. The bolt remains in the target for as long as you focus.

name: Alter Self
description:
You magically change your physical form, gaining one feature that modifies your existing anatomy.

For example, you can grow functional gills on your neck or bear claws on your fingers. This spell can’t grow wings or limbs.
paragraphs: You magically change your physical form, gaining one feature that modifies your existing anatomy.
For example, you can grow functional gills on your neck or bear claws on your fingers. This spell can’t grow wings or limbs.

name: Augury
description:
You interpret the meaning of supernatural portents and omens.

Ask the GM one question about a specific course of action. The GM says whether the action will lead to “weal” or “woe.”
paragraphs: You interpret the meaning of supernatural portents and omens.
Ask the GM one question about a specific course of action. The GM says whether the action will lead to “weal” or “woe.”

name: Bless
description: One creature you touch gains a luck token.
paragraphs: One creature you touch gains a luck token.

name: Blind/Deafen
description:
You utter a divine censure, blinding or deafening one creature you can see in range.

The creature has disadvantage on tasks requiring the lost sense.
paragraphs: You utter a divine censure, blinding or deafening one creature you can see in range.
The creature has disadvantage on tasks requiring the lost sense.

name: Cleansing Weapon
description: One weapon you touch is wreathed in purifying flames. It deals an additional 1d4 damage (1d6 vs. undead) for the duration.
paragraphs: One weapon you touch is wreathed in purifying flames. It deals an additional 1d4 damage (1d6 vs. undead) for the duration.

name: Detect Thoughts
description:
You peer into the mind of one creature you can see within range. Each round, you learn the target’s immediate thoughts.

On its turn, the target makes a Wisdom check vs. your last spellcasting check. If the target succeeds, it notices your presence in its mind and the spell ends.

“Magic is simply the art of doing and undoing." -Creeg, human wizard

name: Fixed Object
description: An object you touch that weighs no more than 5 pounds becomes fixed in its current location. It can support up to 5,000 pounds of weight for the duration of the spell.
paragraphs: An object you touch that weighs no more than 5 pounds becomes fixed in its current location. It can support up to 5,000 pounds of weight for the duration of the spell.

name: Hold Person
description: You magically paralyze one humanoid creature of LV 4 or less you can see within range.
paragraphs: You magically paralyze one humanoid creature of LV 4 or less you can see within range.

name: Invisibility
description:
A creature you touch becomes invisible for the spell's duration.

The spell ends if the target attacks or casts a spell.
paragraphs: A creature you touch becomes invisible for the spell's duration.
The spell ends if the target attacks or casts a spell.

name: Knock
description:
A door, window, gate, chest, or portal you can see within range instantly opens, defeating all mundane locks and barriers.

This spell creates a loud knock audible to all within earshot.
paragraphs: A door, window, gate, chest, or portal you can see within range instantly opens, defeating all mundane locks and barriers.
This spell creates a loud knock audible to all within earshot.

name: Levitate
description:
You can float a near distance vertically per round on your turn.

You can also push against solid objects to move horizontally.
paragraphs: You can float a near distance vertically per round on your turn.
You can also push against solid objects to move horizontally.

name: Mirror Image
description:
You create a number of illusory duplicates of yourself equal to half your level rounded down (minimum 1). The duplicates surround you and mimic you.

Each time a creature attacks you, the attack misses and causes one of the duplicates to evaporate. If all of the illusions have disappeared, the spell ends.
paragraphs: You create a number of illusory duplicates of yourself equal to half your level rounded down (minimum 1). The duplicates surround you and mimic you.

name: Misty Step
description: In a puff of smoke, you teleport a near distance to an area you can see.
paragraphs: In a puff of smoke, you teleport a near distance to an area you can see.

name: Silence
description: You magically mute sound in a near cube within the spell's range. Creatures inside the area are deafened, and any sounds they create cannot be heard.
paragraphs: You magically mute sound in a near cube within the spell's range. Creatures inside the area are deafened, and any sounds they create cannot be heard.

name: Smite
description: You call down punishing flames on a creature you can see within range. It takes 1d6 damage.
paragraphs: You call down punishing flames on a creature you can see within range. It takes 1d6 damage.

name: Web
description: You create a near-sized cube of sticky, dense spider web within the spell's range. A creature stuck in the web can’t move and must succeed on a Strength check vs. your spellcasting check to free itself.
paragraphs: You create a near-sized cube of sticky, dense spider web within the spell's range. A creature stuck in the web can’t move and must succeed on a Strength check vs. your spellcasting check to free itself.

name: Zone Of Truth
description: You compel a creature you can see to speak truth. It can’t utter a deliberate lie while within range.
paragraphs: You compel a creature you can see to speak truth. It can’t utter a deliberate lie while within range.
